I pause, inhaling the scent of fresh cards and possibility.  K♦ 5♠ – K-high offsuit from the big-blind.  A middling hand: not trash (the king has royalty), yet nowhere near “dream-ramps-start-here.”  My read on spiritual equilibrium asks: position?  Already the small-blind has completed to 20 in total; I need 10 more to reach harmony.

A fold would dissipate every atom of my 10-chip investment without offering sentient dialogue from the community cards.  
A call preserves chips for deeper realization and allows the flop to speak its truth at the modest price of 10 more.  
A raise would risk inflating the pot with a marginal king—lust for dominance without inner surety.  

Breath, center, release.

[Call]
